name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.3: align physicalSlot label decode with the kiosks canonical scheme. The dashboard computed slot labels assuming 16 positions per layer (1-16, 21-36); the kiosk uses 9 per layer with columnBaseZero (A1-A9, B21-B29, rejects col>9). This divergence at positions 10+ mislabeled bays, so clicking the bay you thought was A22 could act on a different physical bay. physicalSlot now uses 9/layer and returns the raw code for positions beyond 9, matching the kiosk exactly and giving an injective 1:1 label mapping. Row->code click wiring was verified correct in both grid and restock views. Cumulative over v6.0.2.
